blockers: No Core 0.2 Host adapter has implemented the durable Stream, ACK, replay, resume, epoch-fencing, and Run-terminal requirements.
No Core 0.2 Host Artifact commit and terminal-gating adapter has completed its required fault tests.
No Core 0.2 Host adapter has implemented durable scoped-token issuance, revocation, protected delivery, and security fault tests.
No independent second Host has supplied a complete signed Core 0.2 TCK report.

assertions.summary: Every registered Core message accepts only its declared sender and payload shape.
A release or capability digest mismatch is rejected before business context is disclosed.

verification.scenario: Inject a running release or capability digest mismatch and verify that no input artifact, context, or credential reaches the Agent.

assertions.summary: A restarted writer uses a higher epoch without colliding with prior sequence values.

verification.scenario: Restart an Agent writer after persisted events and prove that the Host fences the old epoch while accepting the higher epoch.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory semantics only; no Host persistence, peer authentication, or failover fault injection.

assertions.summary: Loss of an ACK after durable application replays the prior response without duplicate state.

verification.scenario: Drop an ACK after durable application, reconnect, and prove that replay returns the existing durable response without a second transition.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory semantics only; no durable outbox, transport loss, or Host reconnect integration.

assertions.summary: A stale epoch cannot emit a result, cancel a Run, or commit an Artifact.

verification.scenario: After failover, submit terminal and Artifact frames from the fenced epoch and verify rejection plus safe audit evidence.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory semantics only; terminal, Artifact, audit, and failover integration remain unimplemented.

assertions.summary: A Host or Agent restart restores only provable Run state using snapshot and replay evidence.

verification.scenario: Kill each peer mid-Run, retain the ledger, and prove that resume either restores the correct waterline or produces a typed truthful failure.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference checkpoint round-trip only; no process-kill, durable-store, or Host reconciliation fault injection.

assertions.summary: A required Artifact receipt precedes a successful authoritative terminal record.

verification.scenario: Offer a required Artifact and verify a success proposal is rejected until the Host issues a durable matching receipt.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory semantics only; no Host object-store durability, outbox, or terminal transaction integration.

assertions.summary: Digest, path, media policy, or quota mismatch fails safely without exposing a deliverable.

verification.scenario: Inject mismatched bytes, unsafe source references, disallowed media types, and quota exhaustion; verify typed rejection and no access receipt.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory metadata and byte validation only; no scanner, object-store, or Host access-path fault injection.

assertions.summary: A duplicate Artifact offer returns the prior receipt only for identical bytes and conflicts on changed bytes.

verification.scenario: Submit repeated offers with the same Artifact ID and digest, then with changed bytes, and verify idempotent receipt versus LAP-109 conflict.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory semantics only; no Host durable receipt transaction or multi-process concurrency integration.

assertions.summary: A cancellation-result race produces exactly one authoritative terminal ledger record.

verification.scenario: Race valid cancellation and terminal result frames across repeated schedules and verify one immutable Host terminal record every time.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-process locking only; no durable transaction, Host failover, or multi-process fault injection.

assertions.summary: An external outcome that cannot be proven becomes indeterminate and is not blindly retried.

verification.scenario: Make a reconciled external operation unavailable past deadline and verify the original Run becomes indeterminate without automatic effect repetition.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference terminal semantics only; no external provider adapter, policy engine, or durable reconciliation worker.

assertions.summary: A contract violation reports a safe JSON pointer and actionable recovery metadata.

verification.scenario: Submit a contract-invalid input and output through the Host adapter and verify safe structured error fields with no secret or path disclosure.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference validates error shape only; Host redaction, transport adaptation, and diagnostic-sink verification remain unimplemented.

assertions.summary: A receipt or resume token cannot cross tenant scope or disclose target existence.

verification.scenario: Replay a receipt and resume token from a different tenant and verify indistinguishable safe denial without artifact or Run existence disclosure.

reference_evidence.limitations: Reference in-memory token state only; no Host key management, session delivery, durable revocation audit, rate limiting, or timing-side-channel assessment.
